original_test_intent: Verify the BMC GPU power display, temporary per-GPU power-cap control and actual cap enforcement under GPU stress, then restore the documented default.
original_method: Map every target GPU, snapshot BMC/NVIDIA power and thermal baselines and original limits, apply one approved cap through the BMC GPU Power control, read it back, run a bounded GPU workload sufficient to demand above-cap power while continuously sampling, judge the enforced ceiling with approved tolerance, stop stress, invoke Restore Default and prove every targeted GPU returned to its original/default limit and health state.
manual_activity: The owner approves target GPUs, temporary limits, workload and abort envelope; an operator verifies the BMC control and recovery path and confirms the final default restoration before issuing the verdict.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC and GPU UUID/PCIe/slot map
Supported BMC GPU Power write/read schema
Original and documented default limit per GPU
Approved temporary cap per GPU and valid range
Sampling interval, enforcement tolerance and workload-sufficiency rule
Thermal, power, XID and stability abort thresholds
safety_requirements: Never guess a GPU index or cap value
Do not affect GPUs with active unapproved workloads
Apply the cap only to explicitly mapped targets
Read back every write before stress
Monitor thermals, XID, power and BMC health throughout
Stop on alarm, sensor loss, instability or cap mismatch
Do not automatically retry write, stress or restore
Prove Restore Default by readback and baseline comparison
Preserve logs and do not clear evidence
agent_execution_scope: Apply one approved cap to mapped GPUs
Read back limits and run only the approved bounded stress
Sample NVIDIA and BMC power/thermal telemetry
Stop workload and invoke Restore Default
Verify restored limits/health and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve GPU identities, cap/default values and valid range
Approve workload, duration, tolerance and abort criteria
Authorize each state change and observe recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The nvidia-smi/IPMI reads are supporting telemetry only. They do not apply the BMC cap, create demand, demonstrate limiting or restore the control, and their secret/TLS handling is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the supported BMC GPU Power control for one approved cap/readback, execute a bounded identity-bound GPU stress while sampling complete NVIDIA/BMC power and thermals, then Restore Default and verify every original limit.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The BMC page, fill-in cap, GPU stress, Restore Default and 10/10-minute estimates are retained; the exact cap and stress are required inputs, not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: PER-GPU CAP ENFORCEMENT AND RESTORATION TRANSACTION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each stable GPU identity, record baseline limit/draw, requested and read-back cap, workload demand, time-series power/temperature, maximum/tolerance result, restore response and final limit/health in one transaction ledger.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target safety, measurable enforcement, continuous abort monitoring and provable restoration without altering the source sequence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static readings cannot cover cap mutation, enforced behavior or Restore Default; BMC and driver telemetry must be correlated but may use different sampling windows.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A workload that never demands the cap cannot prove enforcement, while overly aggressive stress or a cap outside supported range can destabilize the GPU or platform.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define whether the cap applies per GPU, module or all GPUs, how default differs from baseline, and what tolerance/sampling proves limiting. The next CPU/system power-cap row is a different resource and cannot reuse this result.
expected_evidence: Verified SUT/BMC/GPU identity map, original/default limits, approved cap/stress/tolerance/abort matrix and approvals
BMC GPU Power baseline and protected cap write/readback per target
Identity-bound workload transcript and synchronized NVIDIA/BMC power/thermal time series
Evidence demand was sufficient plus maximum watts versus cap/tolerance
Restore Default response/readback and original/default limit comparison for every GPU
XID/kernel/SEL/thermal events, abort/recovery actions, no-secret audit and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require inspect, apply cap, stress/verify enforcement and restore default for GPU power.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The cap/default matrix, supported control, safe workload, tolerance and abort limits are normal platform inputs; the GPU control lifecycle is clear.

review_improvement: Replaces the read-only shortcut with the actual per-GPU state transition and adds workload sufficiency, time-series enforcement and deterministic restoration oracles.
independent_technical_reasoning: A cap is proven only when a workload would otherwise request more power and measured draw remains within the approved ceiling and tolerance. A single low reading is inconclusive. Because GPU control scope may be per device or module, stable identity and readback are essential, and the restore result must be checked rather than inferred from the button click.
